scope: Bounded-work native regressions and fixed-source local Debug real-Parquet comparison during concurrent validation.
collector_git_head_note: The report git_head identifies the collector workspace. The baseline executable predates it; baseline_binary_source is its separately frozen actual build source.
plan_identity_note: Full plan hashes include each isolated local fixture URI. The two runtime plans compare equal after removing only that URI; verified source and normalized workload hashes match.

conclusions.answers: All 48 control samples preserve complete normalized answers and independently expected IDs; each retains 21 decorated candidates.
conclusions.timing: Local warm/restarted observations are retained below. Concurrent native/E2E validation prevents attributing a latency change to these refinements. The candidate also includes the latest main merge; this comparison does not isolate the lake changes.
conclusions.scope: Compound probes and mixed-layout pruning have deterministic work checks; nullable real-Parquet tests have independent application-ID and NULL cursor oracles.
conclusions.compatibility: Explicit nulls_ordered preserves missing_rejected defaults; metadata v16 / reader protocol 88 fence new layouts while legacy serving and refresh records remain readable.

compound_membership.unknown_cardinality: Only observed matches are reported with gte; exact count-only/zero-limit execution remains eager.

layout_cohorts.legacy_migration: One final segment descriptor at a time; existing segment root and native payloads retained.

oracle.derivation: The fixed plan retains independently derived expected application IDs for every case. The collector verifies local Parquet content around launches and before completion. Compare also checks normalized complete answers.

comparison.environment_scope: same declared platform and collector; sequential runs are observational, not randomized paired trials
